answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Reaching the harbor of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The plume holds work receipts rather than names, so the reef of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
